variants.name: skipped-phase
variants.breaks: the game node advances the turn's job twice in a frame, so a frame runs two phases
probeFailures: turn/The game advances one phase in each frame, in the order of the service, and ends at idle
turn/A snapshot is published in each of the seven frames of the turn
turn/The end of the turn is published exactly once, in the frame that finishes the last phase

variants.name: leaky-transition
variants.breaks: every click leaves a Godot node behind that nothing frees
probeFailures: rest/Godot counts no orphan node at rest

variants.name: observed-in-frames
variants.breaks: the timed frames read the HUD from the Surface's snapshot, the whole application's status, as they did before the Controls: two full reads in every frame, the one that decides the arrival and the one that records the spinner
probeFailures: observation/No interval between two timed frames contains a read of the Surface's snapshot, which carries everything the application has accumulated

variants.name: heap-leak
